reasons.claim: The chain runs from the compiler's shaykh through Hajjaj, Ibn Jurayj and Ata to Abu Salih, each link written in order.
reasons.quote: أخبرني إبراهيم بن الحسن، عن حجاج، قال قال ابن جريج أخبرني عطاء، عن أبي صالح الزيات

reasons.claim: Abu Hurayra is the Companion heard quoting the Prophet, so he is the last link and the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: أنه سمع أبا هريرة، يقول قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: The stored chain stops at Hajjaj and drops four links the text writes.
reasons.quote: حجاج

reasons.claim: The chain is the compiler's shaykh, his father, his grandfather named, that man's father, then Ibn Abi Umayr.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عن جده أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي، عن أبيه، عن محمد بن أبي عمير

reasons.claim: «يرفعه إلى» is a gap of unnamed transmitters, an unnamed link before the Imam.
reasons.quote: يرفعه إلى أبي عبد الله

reasons.claim: The Imam is written inside the chain after «إلى», so he is the last link as a narrator, and «أبي عبد الله» there is the third time those words stand in the text.
reasons.quote: إلى أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال

reasons.claim: The main chain of both readers is right: the gloss «هو ابن شقيق» is left out and Abdallah b. Amr, to whom the Prophet spoke, is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن وهب بن منبه، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، أن النبي

reasons.claim: The second chain is Tirmidhi's remark about another version, never a route of this saying.
reasons.quote: وروى بعضهم عن معمر

reasons.claim: In that version the chain stops at Wahb and Abdallah b. Amr is only the one the Prophet commanded, so both readers' variant groups wrongly add him as a link.
reasons.quote: عن وهب بن منبه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أمر عبد الله بن عمرو

variant_verdicts.quote: وروى بعضهم عن معمر عن سماك بن الفضل عن وهب بن منبه أن النبي
وروى بعضهم عن معمر عن سماك بن الفضل عن وهب بن منبه أن النبي

levels.surface: أبو بكر بن أبي النضر البغدادي

notes: «هو ابن شقيق» is a gloss and is left out.
«وروى بعضهم» is a remark about another version; in it the chain stops at Wahb, and Abdallah b. Amr is only the one commanded, not a link.

reviews.question: Unruled: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes to a source («فقد رويته عن ...») with no saying; also whether «و الحميريّ» joins Sa'd (both under the two shaykhs, «جميعا» from Ahmad) or is a third shaykh of the compiler.

reasons.claim: The report states the compiler's route to a source and carries no saying, which is an unruled case.
reasons.quote: و ما كان فيه عن عائذ الأحمسيّ فقد رويته عن أبي

reasons.claim: The two shaykhs of the compiler are closed by the dual blessing, and «و الحميريّ» then stands beside Sa'd before «جميعا», which reads most naturally as Sa'd and al-Himyari together from Ahmad, not as a third route from the compiler as both readers have it.
reasons.quote: رضي اللّه عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد اللّه؛ و الحميريّ جميعا عن أحمد

reasons.claim: Reader A itself names the reading in which Sa'd and al-Himyari narrate together from Ahmad, yet does not write it.
reasons.quote: The reading that «جميعا» makes Sa'd and al-Himyari narrate together from Ahmad is the text's own marker

reviews.uncertainty_note: The semicolons leave the place of al-Himyari open, though the order of the text favours his standing beside Sa'd.

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters, the last an unnamed «غير واحد», share one shaykh through «قالوا».
reasons.quote: وسلمة بن شبيب، وغير، واحد، قالوا حدثنا أبو عاصم النبيل

reasons.claim: Abu Humayd is the one heard and the last link; the ten Companions and Abu Qatada are only present.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت أبا حميد الساعدي، في عشرة من أصحاب النبي

reasons.claim: Abu Asim's addition is a remark on wording and adds no route.
reasons.quote: وزاد فيه أبو عاصم عن عبد الحميد بن جعفر هذا الحرف

reasons.claim: The stored chain ends on Abd al-Hamid repeated and drops Abu Humayd.
reasons.quote: عبد الحميد بن جعفر

variant_verdicts.quote: فذكر نحو حديث يحيى بن سعيد بمعناه
فذكر نحو حديث يحيى بن سعيد بمعناه

reasons.claim: The first branch has two co-transmitters joined by «قالا» from Sufyan.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعمرو الناقد، قالا حدثنا سفيان

reasons.claim: Three «ح» branches follow, the third with two co-transmitters from Abd al-Razzaq.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، وعبد بن حميد، قالا أخبرنا عبد الرزاق، أخبرنا معمر

reasons.claim: The fourth branch runs through Ya'qub, his father and Salih, and «أبي» there is the second time the word stands in the text.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم بن سعد، حدثنا أبي، عن صالح

reasons.claim: All branches meet at al-Zuhri and point back with «بهذا الإسناد», a tail written once; with no earlier report supplied it stays a back reference.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن الزهري، بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: The addition in Salih's version is a remark on wording, not a route.
reasons.quote: وزاد في حديث صالح

reasons.claim: The links to Muhammad b. Hamza are right, and «عمن سمع» is an unnamed link.
reasons.quote: عن محمد بن حمزة، عمن سمع

reasons.claim: The Imam is named inside the chain as the one heard, before the saying opens, so he is the last link as a narrator, not an Imam named only after the chain (imam_in_text).
reasons.quote: عمن سمع أبا عبد الله الصادق (عليه السلام) يقول:

notes: «عمن سمع» is an unnamed link; the Imam heard is named inside the chain, so he is the last link as a narrator.
Blessings are left out of the surfaces.

reviews.uncertainty_note: The links and their order are right in both readings; only the kind of the last link changes, and the line between narrator and imam_in_text is drawn from the wording of the rule.

reasons.claim: Amr b. Dinar written with a comma is one man, followed by Amir as the one who told him.
reasons.quote: أخبرني عمرو، بن دينار أن عامر بن سعد، أخبره

reasons.claim: Amir narrates an encounter in which the man who asks and Sa'd who is asked do not relay the saying; Usama speaks and relays the Prophet, so he is the last link.
reasons.quote: أن رجلا سأل سعد بن أبي وقاص عن الطاعون، فقال أسامة بن زيد أنا أخبرك عنه

reasons.claim: The stored chain ends on a word of the question, not a name.
reasons.quote: الطاعون

reasons.claim: Two branches split by «ح» meet with «جميعا» at al-A'mash and point back with «بهذا الإسناد».
reasons.quote: ح وحدثني أبو سعيد، الأشج حدثنا وكيع، جميعا عن الأعمش، بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: A kunya, a comma and a name are one man.
reasons.quote: أبو سعيد، الأشج

reasons.claim: No earlier report is supplied, so the back reference stays as written and cannot be resolved here.
reasons.quote: بهذا الإسناد

variant_verdicts.quote: نحو حديث أبي كريب عن أبي، معاوية إلى آخره
نحو حديث أبي كريب عن أبي، معاوية إلى آخره

reasons.claim: The report opens with a back reference and its own text adds no link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: بِهذَا الإِسناد قالَ: قالَ رَسُولَ

reasons.claim: The seven nearer reports only pass a back reference on, so the chain is inherited from prev8, the nearest report that writes one.
reasons.quote: 221 - وَبِإِسْنادِهِ

reasons.claim: prev8 writes each link with its own «حدثني», ending at Ali b. Abi Talib, whom both readers make the last link.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَني أَبي عَلِىِّ بْنِ أَبِي طالِب

reasons.claim: The two «الحسين بن علي» each stand behind their own «حدثني أبي», so as written they are two links, and both readers keep them.
reasons.quote: قالَ: حَدَّثَني أَبي الحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِى

reasons.claim: Reader A keeps «سيدي» and «أبي» before the names, which are an honorific and bare relations; reader B's names standing alone are the form to store, and the tool counts the two as equal.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَني سَيِّدي عَلىِّ بْنِ مُوسَى الرِّضا

reviews.uncertainty_note: The two successive «الحسين بن علي» are kept as written; whether one of them is a copying slip is for a person, not for structure.
